transform.sql:
-- Bronze keeps values as delivered (strings); silver casts them to the
-- types its schema declares, until write-time enforcement exists (SPEC.md §2).
SELECT
  order_id,
  CAST(sale_date AS DATE) AS sale_date,
  dealership_location,
  salesperson,
  customer_name,
  make,
  model,
  CAST(year AS INT) AS model_year,
  color,
  CAST(mileage AS INT) AS mileage,
  CAST(price AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS price,
  payment_type
FROM (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY _ingested_at DESC
  ) AS _rn
  FROM sales_cars_bronze
  WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
) AS sales_cars_bronze
WHERE _rn = 1
